title: Profile upload to Medtronic error when having too many rows in basals
symptom: After a profile change, the profile was not uploaded to the pump with a noisy alarm. The user found that the profile was too big (added few rows to basals) and managed to recover by reducing the number of rows in basals to 8.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user suspects a limitation of the pump or OrangeLink, while a maintainer suggests it might be a communication timeout issue with the RileyLink clone.
fix: The user recovered by reducing the number of rows in basals to 8. The maintainer notes that sending basals requires a long command (more than 63 bits) and is sent as 3 commands, and if the RileyLink clone has communication problems, it might fail.
evidence_quote: I found out that I have made the profile too big (added few rows to basals) and managed to recover by reducing number of rows in basals to 8.
